
Grok social signals were largely low-confidence (fabricated URLs) or already present in the README. The arXiv RSS batch was dominated by pure ML/NLP/RL papers. One strong candidate emerged: MiGHT-EHR, a multi-task graph transformer for heterogeneous temporal EHR data, which applies transformer architecture to a non-NLP clinical domain with measurable multi-task performance. No other signals cleared the 3-of-4 inclusion threshold with sufficient confidence.

## Suggestions

- [MiGHT-EHR: A Multi-task Graph Transformer for Heterogeneous Temporal Electronic Health Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06430) — Multi-task graph transformer operating on heterogeneous temporal EHR data for clinical prediction tasks, combining graph structure with transformer attention over patient timelines.
  Section: Time-Series & Signals | Criteria: Applies transformer architecture (graph transformer with self-attention) to a non-NLP domain (clinical EHR/health records), Addresses domain-specific tasks with measurable performance (multi-task clinical prediction), Iterative modeling grounded in domain data (heterogeneous temporal EHR sequences and graphs), Empirical outcome demonstrating advantage of transformer approach (multi-task benchmark results on EHR data)
